unresolved_gaps: Alphabet's and Amazon's releases could not be read directly. Search summaries said Alphabet grew 15% in Q1 2024 and 14% in Q2 2024, and Amazon 13% in Q1 2024, but these were not cited.
Measured against 2021 growth rates, 2024 growth was lower for several firms. Under that longer baseline the claim could look different.
The second sentence, about there being no new thing to pick up and acquire, has no measurable test and was not scored.
